source: Starting point, not official. Dave Keuning (Guitar Player): the song, like ~90% of Hot Fuss, was his Ibanez Destroyer into a Fender Hot Rod DeVille. Amp values from tonematch.io (drive 5, bass 5, mids 7, treble 6, reverb 2; the page marks them as approximations). Mixer Mark Needham named a Supro for the guitar amp, which conflicts. The 84 ms Echo Farm delay was on the vocal, so no guitar delay. FD TWIN-R stands in for the Hot Rod.
